nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Hi, I'm a new barpony here!

nodes.speaker: rarity
nodes.text: Oh, Celestia! Such a small filly, and already selling alcohol?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: I'm not small! I'm an adult wealthy pony!

nodes.speaker: rarity
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry for that reaction. Welcome!

nodes.speaker: rarity
nodes.text: Even though you're an adult, I hope you won't sell us too much alcohol.

nodes.speaker: rarity
nodes.text: Of course, I'm not forbidding you to sell such drinks at all. I understand that alcohol is... or will be the basis of your earnings.

nodes.speaker: rarity
nodes.text: I'll support you myself in this case and sacrifice my sobriety for you and your bar.

nodes.speaker: rarity
nodes.text: Just try not to turn us all into alcoholics.
